state.paragraph: In late July 2016, the Company received six LOIs with offer prices per share ranging from $19.20 to $24.00 (implying equity values of $96 million to $121 million). Party B, G&W and another bidder ("Party D") also provided mark-ups of the draft merger agreement and voting agreement. One bidder ("Party E") provided a summary of material issues and proposed changes to the merger agreement and voting agreement with respect to those issues.

ledger_rows.Note: Potential buyers advised to submit non-binding indications of interest by 05/10/2016; communicated before the 04/27 Board meeting.
IOI deadline postponed to 05/19/2016 to let buyers formulate compelling offers; revision itself undated, only bound is the new date.
IOI due date reached; nine IOIs followed; the Transaction Committee evaluated them on 05/23 and 06/01.
Excluded after IOI review as the lowest of the nine offers; decision made at the 05/23 and 06/01 Committee meetings.
Round 2 opened: Committee advanced seven after excluding two, opening management presentations and data-site diligence; LOIs later sought by 07/20.
Signed a confidentiality agreement and received the same memorandum as other buyers; no standstill.
IOI; equity value $108M; no diligence or financing terms stated; made before data-site and management access.
Provided catch-up access for late entrant: data-site access plus telephone management presentation after its 07/12 IOI.
LOI with mark-ups of merger and voting agreements; expedited diligence; highest of the six LOIs.
LOI; 60-day exclusive diligence and documentation period requested; issues list only, no markup.
LOI with mark-ups of merger and voting agreements; four-week diligence period.
LOI: $20.02 cash at closing plus $1.13 CVR on South Quay property sale; three-week exclusive diligence requested; mark-ups provided.
Raised after GHF said price and CVR structure were not competitive; $21.02 cash plus $1.13 CVR; exclusive diligence request stands.

bid.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a bidder submits, revises, confirms or reaffirms a priced proposal, indication of interest or offer for the company. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
